body.text: The one-week stay on the NFA ruling runs out today — and as of this morning there is no confirmation that DOJ has appealed.

Partial-access run covering six days (no Aug 7, 10 or 11 editions). The Reload published five new pieces; all four competitor sites were checked directly. Google News RSS returned empty for the ninth straight run, and justice.gov, CourtListener and the Federal Register were unreachable — so the appeal status is unresolved, not “no appeal.” Verify the N.D. Tex. docket before publishing.

facts.title: 1. Silencer Shop v. ATF — stay expires today, appeal unconfirmed
2. ATF “New Era of Reform” transport rules — comments closed

body.text:
• Silencer Shop stay expires today (T-0); DOJ appeal status unconfirmed
• ATF comment period closed on two interstate-travel rules
• July NICS: NFA checks 130,013, more than double a year ago
• Illinois and Wisconsin courts split on foster-parent gun storage
